messages:
Olivia (partnerships): Quick sync — CloudBay + TensorArc joint session confirmed for Wed May 18 10:30am PT. Need final run-of-show, emcee script, speaker order, demo fallback, and swag pick-up plan. Who's owning?
Diego (events): I can pull the run-of-show and emcee draft. Can we lock speaker order today?
Sam (devrel): I can coordinate demo failover. Suggest ordering: 1) CloudBay keynote, 2) TensorArc live demo, 3) joint Q&A + live troubleshooting.
Priya (eng-ml): For TensorArc demo: plan A uses 2xA100 on prem, plan B uses hosted Redwood model (latency OK) — need to confirm creds and network.
Diego (events): Good. Olivia, can you confirm sponsor slot length? They have 18min + 7 Qs per contract.
Olivia (partnerships): Yes 18 + 7. Emcee needs 30s intro + 60s transition between speakers.
Sam (devrel): Demo fallback script (short):
```
If on-prem GPU fails:
- switch to https://api.redwood.ai/sessions/partner-test
- run canned notebook: /demos/tensorarc-fallback.ipynb
- notify Ops via #eng-oncall
```
Diego (events): Love that — I'll add to run-of-show.
Priya (eng-ml): Access: I need CloudBay infra contact and a test account for the hosted endpoint. Olivia, can you loop them in?
Olivia (partnerships): Looping in now: @cloudbay-eng @tensorarc-prod (I'll DM details). Also we need: 1) one signed NDA for on-prem access, 2) KMS policy reviewed if they want RMK.
OpsBot: Reminder: request for live KVM/network staging must be submitted 72 hours before event to eng-ops.
Diego (events): Swag plan: 150 partner-branded kits. Logistics: pickup on Tue 5/17 at 4pm from SF HQ shipping bay. Who can collect?
Sam (devrel): I can grab them Tue afternoon. Will need a small checklist: stickers, T-shirt sizes, USB-C dongles, printed one-pager.
Olivia (partnerships): Emcee script draft (high level):
- 0:00–0:30 host intro + Redwood positioning line
- 0:30–1:00 partner shout (CloudBay)
- 1:00–6:30 CloudBay demo (18min total -> split)
- 6:30–7:30 transition + quick sponsor plug
- 7:30–25:30 TensorArc live demo (with fallback at 20:00)
- 25:30–31:00 joint Q&A + wrap
Diego (events): Timing math looks off (we have 18 + 18?). Double-check segments — but emcee script good to iterate.
Priya (eng-ml): Note on fallback latency: hosted Redwood route adds ~70ms token latency; acceptable for slide and short generation demos but not for multi-user interactive. We'll keep pre-generated responses for fallback heavy flows.
Olivia (partnerships): Action items: @Diego finalize run-of-show + slide cue sheet; @Sam prepare fallback notebook and printed cheat-sheets; @Priya get test creds + confirm KMS ask; Olivia to confirm swag pickup and NDAs. Aim to close by EOD Friday.
Diego (events): I'll post run-of-show v1 in this thread by EOD today.
Sam (devrel): I'll drop the fallback notebook link and a 1-page cheat sheet here tomorrow AM.
Priya (eng-ml): I'll ping infra and update with credential ETA.
Olivia (partnerships): Thanks everyone :rocket: Any other blockers?
Diego (events): None from events side.
OpsBot: Note: create incident channel #live-cloudbay-tensorarc for the event day.
Sam (devrel): Good call, will join and be on standby.
Olivia (partnerships): Closing thread for action tracking — post updates here.
